title: National Preparedness Month: Wildfires
description: In 2014, 38,000 wildfires burned more than 2.7 million acres across the United States. During National Preparedness Month, make it a priority to free your home and surrounding areas of debris and flammable vegetation, such as pine needles, tree limbs, bushes and trees. If you fail to plan, you plan to fail!

transcript.text: Wildfires are an inevitable force of nature that cannot be avoided, but an eventuality that can be prepared for.
These wildfires are typically triggered by lightning or accidents.
The fires spread quickly, igniting brush, trees, and homes.
Preparing your home can help control the damage and possible loss of property.
Practicing wildfire safety is an important tool when keeping yourself and family members safe in the event of an emergency.
